verification_policy: Direct research with cross-source acquisition verification. Preserve source conflicts and do not infer Ultimate Finish requirements without explicit evidence.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 reference material identifies Super Kamehameha as a Ki Blast Ultimate with a multi-hitting beam and 300 Ki cost for the standard version.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Current reference material lists Training with Goku — Lesson 4 as the unlock route.
verification_audit.ultimate_finish_policy: No Ultimate Finish requirement is asserted. The evidence establishes instructor training rather than a PQ reward condition, so the field remains null.
verification_audit.variant_policy: Super Kamehameha (SS4 DAIMA) and DUAL Super Kamehameha are separate skill identities and are not merged into this record.
verification_audit.damage_policy: Exact damage percentages and hit totals are not promoted as canonical database values because version stability is not established.

records.name: Super Kamehameha
records.character_source: Goku and multiple customizable partners/character presets documented by current references
records.skill_description: A multi-hitting Ki Blast Ultimate that charges a large Kamehameha and fires a fast beam straight ahead.
records.mechanics_notes: Current reference material classifies the standard Super Kamehameha as a blue, multi-hitting beam with finite range. SSGSS Gogeta has a distinct power-up interaction during the charge, while Gohan (DBS Super Hero) has a distinct counter interaction; those character-specific variants are preserved as mechanics notes rather than separate canonical skills here.
